tickets.title: Unify the repository workspace and lockfile
tickets.delivers: One root npm installation graph and lockfile for Desktop and Worker without changing product behavior.

tickets.title: Create the shared-core public boundary
tickets.delivers: The explicit core subpaths, project references, exports, adapter contracts, and enforced import policy before production behavior moves.

tickets.title: Create the Android Expo development-client build path
tickets.delivers: An Android-only Expo project, separate development identity, custom development client, and local or EAS build commands with no product feature code.

tickets.title: Create the evidence catalog and verifier foundation
tickets.delivers: A versioned capability-keyed evidence schema and one resumable local or CI verifier command that every later ticket can extend.

tickets.title: Create the Integration Relay build and environment boundary
tickets.delivers: A separate Integration Relay workspace and Cloudflare deployment boundary with shared relay envelopes, development and production configuration isolation, and no product endpoints yet.

tickets.title: Extract Platform identity and reliability foundations
tickets.delivers: Core Platform, ChannelRef, stable identifiers, portable results, errors, retry decisions, fixtures, and temporary narrow Desktop re-exports.

tickets.title: Extract normalized content and chat contracts
tickets.delivers: Provider-neutral Stream, Channel, Category, Video, Clip, and chat contracts with serialized timestamps and no provider or IPC leakage.

tickets.title: Extract discovery rules and use cases
tickets.delivers: Portable identity matching, search validation, ranking, deduplication, pagination, and progressive discovery behavior while Desktop remains unchanged.

tickets.title: Migrate top-stream discovery through IPlatformReader
tickets.delivers: Desktop Home reaches Twitch and Kick top streams through the core reader port and explicit composition instead of provider self-registration.

tickets.title: Migrate Search, Channels, and Categories through core ports
tickets.delivers: Desktop Search, Channel, Categories, and Category Detail use normalized core contracts and explicitly composed Platform adapters.

tickets.title: Migrate Videos and Clips through core ports
tickets.delivers: Desktop video and clip discovery uses normalized core ports without moving playback, Electron, or provider transports into core.

tickets.title: Migrate follows and Guest Follow policy through core
tickets.delivers: Desktop Following and Guest Follows use portable follow policy and narrow Platform reader capabilities while provider writes stay in Desktop adapters.

tickets.title: Extract OAuth2Session semantics and migrate Desktop auth
tickets.delivers: Portable session state, single-flight refresh, auth-lost behavior, and capability ports with credentials, schedules, endpoints, and Worker calls retained in adapters.

tickets.title: Extract chat and Live Notification policy
tickets.delivers: Core ChatConnection, normalized events, send eligibility, follow-alert policy, and notification decisions while sockets and presentation remain Desktop-owned.

tickets.title: Close the Desktop migration and open Android feature work
tickets.delivers: All portable callers use core public exports, compatibility re-exports and migration exceptions are gone, and the extraction-complete predicate passes.

tickets.title: Compose the Mobile runtime and enforce its layers
tickets.delivers: Mobile UI, controllers, transport, adapters, persistence, native bridges, and the sole composition root with executable import boundaries.

tickets.title: Deliver the adaptive five-destination Android shell
tickets.delivers: Search, Following, Watch, Activity, and More use static Android navigation, independent histories, adaptive rail behavior, Dark Theater tokens, and stable review selectors.

tickets.title: Deliver encrypted Product and Cache Stores
tickets.delivers: SQLCipher Product and Cache Stores, SecureStore secrets, transactional migrations, quarantine and recovery, bounded cache eviction, and backup exclusions.

tickets.title: Deliver Activity, deep links, and lifecycle restoration
tickets.delivers: Durable Activity Items, read state, event deduplication, nested destination links, destination restoration, and explicit process-death behavior without remote push.

tickets.title: Create the typed Android capability-module boundary
tickets.delivers: Small Expo module contracts for playback, Media Jobs, captions, diagnostics, and maintenance with stable typed errors and no all-purpose bridge.

tickets.title: Measure Capability Profile and apply Runtime Degradation
tickets.delivers: Install qualification, measured device capacity, visible ordered degradation with hysteresis, and diagnostic evidence that preserves the focused task and artifacts.

tickets.title: Deliver Installation Identity and signed capability policy
tickets.delivers: Rotating installation credentials, relay authorization and abuse controls, and a monotonic signed Capability Manifest with safe expiry behavior across the prepared Mobile and Relay boundaries.

tickets.title: Connect and maintain a Twitch account
tickets.delivers: Accessible Twitch Device Code login, validation, atomic one-time refresh rotation, scope status, disconnect, and Accounts presentation.

tickets.title: Connect and maintain a Kick account
tickets.delivers: System-browser S256 PKCE, state validation, verified App Link, exact Worker callback allowlist, token refresh, scope status, disconnect, and Accounts presentation.

tickets.title: Deliver direct signed-in and relay signed-out Platform reads
tickets.delivers: Normalized Twitch and Kick reader adapters, narrow secret-backed signed-out relay endpoints, TanStack Query ownership, bounded cache projections, and isolated Platform failure.

tickets.title: Deliver Home and Channel Detail
tickets.delivers: Home recommendations and Channel Detail Home, Videos, and Clips tabs with avatars, thumbnails, Platform state, refresh age, and failure containment.

tickets.title: Deliver unified Search and local history
tickets.delivers: Bottom floating search, ten-entry typed history, filters, imagery, and the All, Channels, Streams, Videos, Clips, and Categories result states.

tickets.title: Deliver Categories and Category Detail
tickets.delivers: Searchable category art opens the selected Category Detail with Live Streams, Clips, and Videos states plus Platform, language, tag, and sort filters.

tickets.title: Deliver Following and Guest Follows
tickets.delivers: Live-first Following, Guest Follows, supported account imports, provider-page actions, local search, notification preferences, and Live Notification Projection commands across five tab states.

tickets.title: Resolve and watch one live Stream
tickets.delivers: A focused native HLS Watch session for Twitch and Kick with playback-source compatibility adapters, policy state, visible fallback, Info, and Related content.

tickets.title: Deliver player controls, movable mini-player, and Android PiP
tickets.delivers: Transport and quality controls, fullscreen and orientation, safe-region draggable mini-player, one focused Android PiP session, and deterministic restoration.

tickets.title: Watch Videos and Clips
tickets.delivers: Video and Clip Watch routes with seeking, progress, Details, Comments placeholder ownership, Related content, compatibility state, and deep-link entry.

tickets.title: Deliver typed Watch History
tickets.delivers: Durable Stream, Video, and Clip history with thumbnails, avatars, timestamps, progress, resume, replay, local search, and offline reading.

tickets.title: Deliver Twitch foreground chat
tickets.delivers: Visible-only Twitch EventSub chat receive, direct Helix send, scope and eligibility states, reconnection, deduplication, and explicit gaps in Watch Chat.

tickets.title: Deliver Kick foreground chat through the relay
tickets.delivers: Verified Kick webhook receipt, channel-sharded foreground fanout without history, direct official chat send, reconnection, deduplication, and explicit gaps.

tickets.title: Deliver chat cosmetics and replay
tickets.delivers: Platform and approved third-party emotes, badges, paints, bounded caches, and synchronized Video or Clip comments and replay with visible source gaps.

tickets.title: Deliver managed-channel moderation
tickets.delivers: Searchable managed channels, contextual chat actions, and Chat, Retention, Mod log, Banned, Engagement, Unban, Moderators, and VIPs states with explicit Platform support.

tickets.title: Deliver capability-aware Multistream
tickets.delivers: Up to six retained StreamSlots, measured active-video limits, one audio owner, focused chat and captions, visible ordered degradation, and layout restoration.

tickets.title: Deliver playback filtering as an isolated compatibility capability
tickets.delivers: Playback filtering behind a narrow adapter with signed policy, canary, independent disablement, diagnostics, disclosure, and a player-only failure boundary.

tickets.title: Deliver proxy and connectivity behavior
tickets.delivers: Supported proxy configuration, connectivity observation, request cancellation, bounded retry, Platform isolation, stale-cache state, and actionable diagnostics.

tickets.title: Deliver the recoverable Media Job engine
tickets.delivers: Durable job intent, idempotent commands, native generation, checkpoints, visible service ownership, journal and file reconciliation, and Activity updates.

tickets.title: Download and explicitly export Videos and Clips
tickets.delivers: Contextual download, progress, pause, resume, retry, cancel, delete, app-private completion, and explicit Android export with no standalone media screen.

tickets.title: Record and recover a live Stream
tickets.delivers: User-started segmented recording, visible foreground service, Stop control, checkpoints, four-hour warning, safe cutoff, and playable partial-artifact recovery.

tickets.title: Caption the focused Stream locally
tickets.delivers: A visible 43.11 MiB English model lifecycle and one real-time caption session on the focused Stream with local-only audio processing.

tickets.title: Deliver appearance and player Settings
tickets.delivers: Searchable Appearance, Playback, Player controls, Buffer, and Multiview panels whose durable choices apply to live behavior.

tickets.title: Deliver chat and integration Settings
tickets.delivers: Searchable Chat, Predictions, Integrations, and API tokens panels with secure values and direct links to the behavior they configure.

tickets.title: Deliver notification and network Settings
tickets.delivers: Searchable Notifications, Ad blocking, and Proxy panels with Product Store authority, safe defaults, denial recovery, and active integration status.

tickets.title: Deliver update, support, and maintenance Settings
tickets.delivers: Searchable Updates, Diagnostics, Logs, Report a bug, and About panels plus account and local-data maintenance actions with scoped confirmation.

tickets.title: Deliver Android Diagnostics and sanitized reports
tickets.delivers: Overview, Resources, I/O, Traces, Logs and reports, and Developer tools states with Capability Profile, degradation causes, redacted exports, and safe recovery.

tickets.title: Register native FCM delivery and present notifications
tickets.delivers: In-context permission, native FCM token registration, Live, Media, and Account or Device channels, safe payload handling, Activity reconciliation, and current-data routing.

tickets.title: Deliver scalable topic and direct-token fanout
tickets.delivers: Versioned preference projection reconciliation, stable channel topics, one-mode event delivery, private direct tokens, 2,000-topic overflow, retries, and invalid-token retirement.

tickets.title: Prove notification scale and lifecycle recovery
tickets.delivers: A repeatable 100,000-recipient dispatch proof within 30 seconds plus simultaneous event, retry, mismatch, reinstall, ended Stream, offline, and force-stop evidence.

tickets.title: Establish production identity, EAS build authority, and signing recovery
tickets.delivers: Registered com.thedarkskyxd.streamfusion identity, separate development identity, StreamFusion Expo ownership, committed versions, controlled EAS build start, and recovered production signer proof.

tickets.title: Deliver the signed GitHub APK updater
tickets.delivers: Manual or daily stable-release checks, validated metadata, resumable private APK download, digest and signer verification, explicit PackageInstaller handoff, and cleanup.

tickets.title: Automate the four Android verification gates
tickets.delivers: Change, Main, Candidate, and Public Release automation with API 30 and current emulator journeys, physical roles, live canaries, accessibility, performance, security, and fail-closed evidence freshness.

tickets.title: Promote one exact APK into an immutable Android Release Set
tickets.delivers: Protected second-approval promotion of one EAS build ID into a matched immutable Release Set, plus metadata withdrawal and same-key forward-fix rehearsal.

tickets.title: Close every Android parity record
tickets.delivers: Every capability on the current generated Desktop ledger has an allowed Android outcome, owner, current evidence, no blocker, and complete route, panel, and tab coverage.

tickets.title: Pass the complete Candidate Gate twice
tickets.delivers: Two consecutive clean runs for the same candidate across the full emulator, physical, live-provider, lifecycle, accessibility, performance, security, installation, and recovery matrices.

tickets.title: Publish the first Public Android Release
tickets.delivers: The exact approved APK and matched immutable Android Release Set become the first public GitHub release only after the complete fail-closed predicate passes.
